abundance.purpose: What each abundance layer APB2 writes measures, and whether the software normalizes it across runs: intensity, MS1 intensity, MaxLFQ, iBAQ or directLFQ, normalized never or as the run's settings chose. Every layer an APB2 rule marks with the role abundance carries an entry, except DIA-NN's gene-group Genes.MaxLFQ on the protein-group level.
used_by: apb-proteobench: modules that ask for an abundance normalization, such as dia_plasma

confidence.purpose: How likely each identification, or the signal quantified for it, is correct: per-run PEP and q-value layers, per-feature PEP, Sage's MS1-peak q-value, DIA-NN's and Spectronaut's protein-group q-values per run, per library and across the experiment, and MaxQuant's across the experiment. Scores, vendor summaries and other vendors' protein-level confidence are left out.
used_by: apb-aggregate: confidence-weighted rollups rlm_confidence_case and rlm_confidence_precision
apb-export: the prolfqua target's qValue, pg_qValue and pg_qValue_experiment layers

proteobench_entrapment.purpose: The precursor q-values ProteoBench's entrapment scoring ranks by: run, library and experiment-wide q-values on the peptidoform-ion level, each its own kind. Only the vendors ProteoBench's entrapment module accepts carry entries.
used_by: apb-export: the msmu target's q_value layer and the prolfqua target's qValue fallback

apb.purpose: The fields APB writes for every vendor, by kind instead of by name: ProForma_peptide, ProForma_peptidoform, ProForma_ion and ProForma_fragment, apb_Decoy and apb_Contaminant, the var columns a rule marks with the roles protein_assignment and fasta_accessions, and a sample annotation's condition and biological replicate. Its requirements say which levels carry each.
used_by: apb-export: export rules ask for APB's own columns by kind

chromatography.purpose: Chromatographic retention times, elution-peak bounds and peak widths retained by APB2, with their reviewed original unit. Measured, aligned, predicted and library retention times are different kinds and are not interchangeable; iRT values are not times. Units that depend on the acquisition or are not established remain unknown.
used_by: apb-export: QPX feature retention times in seconds for pMultiQC
